نحدودق (form XII)
# نَحْدَوْدِقُ (naḥdawdiqu) /naħ.daw.di.qu/: first-person plural non-past active indicative of اِحْدَوْدَقَ (iḥdawdaqa)
# نَحْدَوْدِقَ (naḥdawdiqa) /naħ.daw.di.qa/: first-person plural non-past active subjunctive of اِحْدَوْدَقَ (iḥdawdaqa)
# نَحْدَوْدِقْ (naḥdawdiq) /naħ.daw.diq/: first-person plural non-past active jussive of اِحْدَوْدَقَ (iḥdawdaqa)
kaikki_vikisozluk.t: See the etymology of the corresponding lemma form.
